characters.notes: Neither roster_text file for Jamie has a jump row, so the draft's jump value cannot be checked from these files. Draft reversals already present (OD Arrow Kick, both supers, CA) and command grabs (Tenshin, OD Tenshin, Drink level 3 or higher) match Capcom's rows on start-up. Bakkai (Drink level 2 or higher) has projectile-only invulnerability starting frame 3-5; projectile invulnerability is not one of the brief's classes so it is not listed, but the sources differ on its end frame (Capcom line 84 'frames 3 - 24' vs SuperCombo line 97 'invuln=3-43 Projectile'). Luminous Dive Kick is jump-only and was excluded.
